_: Copy this to ai-settings.json and put your key in it. That file is gitignored; this one is the shape, with no key in it.
_mcp_servers: Tool (MCP) servers an AI node may use, keyed by the name a graph refers to them by. An entry is what an MCP server's README gives you for Claude Desktop's "mcpServers" -- {command, args, env, cwd} -- or {url, headers} for a server reached over HTTP. A graph can only *name* a server: the command line lives here, on your machine, so opening someone else's graph can never start a program you did not choose. A graph may also give an http(s) URL directly; that gets no headers from this file. Delete the two examples if you use neither.
_providers: google | openai | anthropic | ollama | lmstudio | openai_compatible | github_copilot
_keys: google -> aistudio.google.com/apikey (free tier) | openai -> OPENAI_API_KEY | anthropic -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
